Fantastic for gluten free!
Jul 2025 • Couples
We found Pizza and Bia as I was looking for gluten free food. All of the pasta was able to be made gluten free, and staff were reassuring when I informed them of my allergy. I had the spaghetti bolognese which was fantastic. There were no options for GF pizza but I was more than happy with the pasta options available. 

My boyfriend had the Parma ham and rocket pizza (not GF) which he said was lovely and light. 

We enjoyed x2 beers and x2 glasses of the house white - both great. 

For dessert, my boyfriend had the New York cheese cake (not GF) which he really enjoyed. I had a GF brownie with ice cream, which was rich and tasty. 

Service was polite, efficient and friendly. The atmosphere was relaxing. 

We paid 1,477,800 VND, which is around £42 gbp. This was a more expensive meal compared to other meals we have had in Ho Chi Minh, however, we felt it was reasonable due to the quality of food and service.
